name: Sakuya wa Pasta ga Tabetakatta no ni
original_name: サクヤはパスタが食べたかったのに
source:
Sakuya wanted to eat pasta.

He wanted to eat pasta, which meant that he couldn't eat it.

Why could Sakuya not eat pasta?
This was solely due to the fact that Sakuya had feelings for Clara.
Because Clara called pasta "spaghetti".

Will Sakuya be able to eat pasta in front of Clara who calls it spaghetti?

A tale from long ago, near and yet so far.

[Translated from [url=https://3on10.com/sakupasu/]official website[/url]]
